title: Conversation memory: what the assistant keeps, for whom and for how long

videos.script: An assistant that remembers is more useful. It is also a store of personal data that the model writes for itself. {{title}} Here the model proposes memories from three messages of one client. It proposed a CPF, a phone number and a surgery. {{proposals}} The code refused all three, with a reason for each, and kept four ordinary facts. {{rules}} The model also missed the most useful one. The client asked for replies in Portuguese, and no memory says so. {{missed}} Every memory belongs to one account and carries a date. Another client sees none of it. {{scope}} After the date, the assistant stops using a memory. But the line stays on disk until the sweep deletes it. {{sweep}} And the client can see what is remembered, and delete any line of it. {{forget}}
